en: Language is saved in this browser only.
zh: 语言选择仅保存在当前浏览器中。

en: Language changed for this page. Browser storage is unavailable.
zh: 已为当前页面切换语言，浏览器存储不可用。

en: English and Simplified Chinese are available for the website and Web interface. The first visit follows your browser language. An explicit choice saves only the language code under rillora.locale.v1 in this browser.
zh: 网站和 Web 界面提供英语与简体中文。首次访问时跟随浏览器语言；手动选择后，仅将语言代码保存在当前浏览器的 rillora.locale.v1 中。

en: This preference contains no account or private-map information and is not used for advertising or analytics. Each site stores its own choice; links to the Rillora web app carry only the language code. Clear browser storage to follow your browser language again. If storage is unavailable, switching still works for this page.
zh: 该偏好不包含账号或私密事务地图信息，也不用于广告或分析。各网站分别保存选择；前往 Rillora Web 应用的链接仅携带语言代码。清除浏览器存储后会重新跟随浏览器语言。存储不可用时，仍可为当前页面切换语言。

en: Language does not change your service market, currency, price or sharing permissions. Official legal documents, hosted sign-in and provider guidance may remain in English. Your saved content is not translated.
zh: 语言不会改变服务地区、币种、价格或共享权限。正式法律文件、托管登录和平台指南可能仍为英文。已保存的内容不会被翻译。

en: Light or Dark is saved on this device. System clears that choice.
zh: 浅色或深色选择保存在当前设备。选择跟随系统会清除该偏好。

en: Changed for this page. Browser storage is unavailable.
zh: 已为当前页面更改外观，浏览器存储不可用。
2026 年 9 月 29 日 · 网站外观更新

en: On the Rillora website and web app, choosing Light or Dark saves only that choice in this browser under rillora.website.appearance.v1. It is used only to display your chosen appearance, contains no account or private-map information, and is not used for advertising or analytics.
zh: 在 Rillora 网站和 Web 应用中，选择浅色或深色时，仅将该选择保存在当前浏览器的 rillora.website.appearance.v1 中。它只用于显示所选外观，不包含账号或私密事务地图信息，也不用于广告或分析。

en: The choice remains until you select System or clear browser storage. Links from the website carry only this display choice to the web app. Each site keeps its own local preference; nothing is linked to your account. System removes the saved choice and follows your device. If browser storage is unavailable, the control still works for the current page.
zh: 该选择会保留，直到您选择跟随系统或清除浏览器存储。网站链接只将该显示偏好带到 Web 应用；各网站分别在本地保存偏好，不会关联账号。选择跟随系统会移除已保存的选择，并跟随设备外观。存储不可用时，仍可为当前页面更改外观。

en: What should I keep in Rillora?
Account names, document locations, safe references and clear next steps. Keep passwords, seed phrases, private keys and complete recovery codes out of your map.
zh: 账号名称、文件位置、非敏感的识别信息，以及清晰的后续步骤。不要在事务地图中保存密码、助记词、私钥或完整恢复码。

en: Does my family need the app?
No. They can open your invitation on the web, sign in or create their own account, and accept. They see only the matters and details you choose to share.
zh: 不需要。对方可以在网页中打开邀请，登录或注册自己的账号，再接受邀请。他们只能看到您选择共享的事项和详细信息。

zh: 每位受邀者看到的内容都可以单独设置。您可以更改或撤销其在线访问权限，但无法收回对方已经保存的副本。
Rillora 会转移我的账号吗？

en: No. Rillora organises information and directions. After signing in, account inheritance guidance helps you find official processes. Each provider and the applicable legal process decide access, closure or transfer.
zh: 不会。Rillora 用于整理信息与查找指引。登录后，账号身后处理指南可帮助您找到官方流程。账号访问、关闭或转移由各服务商与适用法律程序决定。
